title: An update from Ed Bastian to SkyMiles Members: What’s new and what's next at Delta
summary: CEO Ed Bastian sent an update via email to SkyMiles Members with recent and upcoming travel.|
body_markdown:
Thank you for choosing Delta. You trust us with moments that matter,
and we take that seriously. I want to acknowledge those of you whose
travel was disrupted by the nationwide ground stop earlier this month.
Thanks to your patience and the dedication of our people, we were
able to get customers safely to their destinations, and we remain
committed to serving you with excellence on every journey.


We're looking forward to welcoming you during your upcoming holiday
travels and are ready to serve you in the weeks ahead. Across our
network and throughout your journey, we’re investing to earn your trust
every day — in the experience on board, the places we fly, and the
ways we reward you. Here’s what’s ahead.


# restaurant


ELEVATING YOUR EXPERIENCE


We recently unveiled the[next era of Delta One](https://news.delta.com/new-era-delta-one?mkcpgn=EM_MKTG_SPOP___AA123456_A01A_55490289_261111) , featuring a reimagined culinary, beverage and hospitality experience that launches on select LAX international flights this fall and expands across the network next year. In every cabin, you will also notice enhancements to the connected seatback experience, delivering personalized entertainment and real-time trip updates — plus, access to a growing ecosystem of partner experiences and offers through[Delta Sync](https://www.delta.com/us/en/about-delta/sync?mkcpgn=EM_MKTG_SPOP___AA123456_A01A_55490289_261111) . At the same time, our fleet modernization continues with next-generation aircraft arriving monthly.


Delta continues to expand onboard connectivity with more than 95% of our aircraft now equipped with fast, free global Wi-Fi. Last month, we extended coverage to our trans-Pacific routes, bringing Wi-Fi coverage to some of our longest flights. Early next year, we will offer free Wi-Fi on our entire fleet, and in the meantime, Viasat’s new satellite technology is already boosting Wi-Fi speeds across the Americas.


On the ground, Delta operates the largest U.S. airline lounge network with 60 Delta Sky Clubs worldwide, including five Delta One Lounges — our[newest at LAX](https://news.delta.com/delta-deepens-investment-lax-phase-1-second-delta-one-lounge-now-open?mkcpgn=EM_MKTG_SPOP___AA123456_A01A_55490289_261111) . As we continue investing in the airport experience, you’ll see new and renovated Clubs and Lounges across our system.


# language


EXPANDING YOUR WORLD


This summer, Delta operated our largest-ever trans-Atlantic schedule with more than 650 weekly flights to nearly 30 European destinations. Interest in European travel remains strong, and we recently added seven new routes, including Sardinia and Malta from New York City. We’re also bringing more international service to focus markets like Austin with the launch of daily nonstop service to Paris in March 2027, Austin’s only nonstop service to Europe offered by a U.S. airline.


Beyond Europe, we’re expanding our presence in Asia and the Middle East. As Los Angeles’ No. 1 airline, we recently launched service to Hong Kong and will add Manila in March 2027, further strengthening our Pacific network and supporting our[largest-ever LAX schedule](https://news.delta.com/delta-expands-position-los-angeles-1-airline-largest-ever-schedule-premium-experience-and-more?mkcpgn=EM_MKTG_SPOP___AA123456_A01A_55490289_261111) next summer. We’ll also launch a new nonstop flight from Atlanta to Riyadh next year, connecting the U.S. with Saudi Arabia’s capital and creating new opportunities for business and tourism.


# luggage


REWARDING YOUR LOYALTY


We are continuing to raise the bar on what it means to be a SkyMiles Member. That’s why we’re expanding and strengthening partnerships with brands you know and love like Starbucks, Uber and Airbnb. We celebrated 30 years of partnership with American Express this year and introduced new[travel benefits](https://news.delta.com/more-travel-value-added-delta-skymiles-cards-no-increase-annual-fees?mkcpgn=EM_MKTG_SPOP___AA123456_A01A_55490289_261111) like a complimentary second checked bag on domestic flights — all with no increase to the annual fee. And with the addition of[Hyatt](https://news.delta.com/delta-and-hyatt-launch-new-benefits-and-experiences-skymilesr-and-world-hyatt-members) , we're extending the premium travel experience beyond the flight. Hyatt gives Members access to distinctive and elevated experiences around the world. Together, our portfolio of SkyMiles partners makes your travel journey more seamless and rewarding from start to finish.


Last year, Delta became the first U.S. airline to turn 100. As we begin our second century, our goal is to connect more of the world than ever before while building a sustainable and accessible future for air travel. Today, only one in five people worldwide have ever been on an airplane — a statistic that points to our greatest area of opportunity. We’re excited to bring the magic of flight to many more travelers in the years ahead.


With Thanksgiving just a few days away, I want to offer my gratitude to
every one of you for your loyalty to Delta. Thank you for the trust you
place in us and for being a valued SkyMiles Member. We’re honored
to connect you to the people and places that matter most.


Happy Thanksgiving to you and your families!


Keep Climbing,


###
Ed Bastian
CEO
